# Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks

Maps incoming App Links, Universal Links, and custom schemes to handlers or Shell routes, with optional auth-restore.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-deep-links/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.6 (3 September 2026). Fail-closed allowlists: empty Hosts rejects HTTPS; empty CustomSchemes rejects custom schemes. http:// needs AllowInsecureHttp. PermissiveMode = true restores the old open behavior.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks

Registration: `UseMauiDeepLinks` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I handle Universal Links / App Links in MAUI?
- Custom scheme myapp://orders/123 routing
- Restore a deep link after login

## Do not use when

- The payload is an FCM/APNs tap without a URI — use Plugin.Maui.PushRouter
- MAUI AppLinkRequestReceived already covers a single custom scheme
